questions.question: Determine the ratio of the number of students who play Football to the number of students who play Basketball in a survey of 120 students from the following table. Category Number Play Football and Basketball 25 Play Football but not Basketball 45 Play Basketball but not Football 35 Play neither sport 15
questions.questionHtml:
Determine the ratio of the number of students who play Football to the number of students who play Basketball in a survey of 120 students from the following table.

Category Number
Play Football and Basketball 25
Play Football but not Basketball 45
Play Basketball but not Football 35
Play neither sport 15
questions.solution:
⇒ Total Football = 45 + 25 = 70

⇒ Total Basketball = 35 + 25 = 60

⇒ Required ratio = 70 : 60 = 7 : 6

questions.question: Tina and Meera started a business with ₹1,00,000 and ₹80,000 respectively. After 6 months, Meera added ₹40,000 more. Tina withdrew ₹20,000 at the same time. What is the profit-sharing ratio at the end of 1 year?
questions.questionHtml: Tina and Meera started a business with ₹1,00,000 and ₹80,000 respectively. After 6 months, Meera added ₹40,000 more. Tina withdrew ₹20,000 at the same time. What is the profit-sharing ratio at the end of 1 year?
questions.solution:
Tina's capital for first 6 months = 100000 × 6 = 600000

Remaining capital of Tina after withdrawal = 100000 − 20000 = 80000

Tina's capital for next 6 months = 80000 × 6 = 480000

Total capital-time of Tina = 600000 + 480000 = 1080000

Meera's capital for first 6 months = 80000 × 6 = 480000

New capital of Meera after addition = 80000 + 40000 = 120000

Meera's capital for next 6 months = 120000 × 6 = 720000

Total capital-time of Meera = 480000 + 720000 = 1200000

Required ratio = 1080000 : 1200000 = 9 : 10

questions.question: A invests ₹20,000, while B invests ₹30,000. A receives an additional 20% for management. The total profit is ₹60,000. What is A's share?
questions.questionHtml: A invests ₹20,000, while B invests ₹30,000. A receives an additional 20% for management. The total profit is ₹60,000. What is A's share?
questions.solution:
⇒ Base ratio of A : B = 20000 : 30000 = 2 : 3

⇒ A gets additional profit = 60000 × 20 ÷ 100 = 12000

⇒ Remaining profit = 60000 − 12000 = 48000

⇒ A's share from ratio = 48000 × 2 ÷ 5 = 19200

⇒ Total share of A = 19200 + 12000 = 31200

questions.question: The average of 13 numbers is 70. The average of the first five numbers is 60. The average of the next five numbers is 25 % higher than the average of the first five numbers. The 11th number is 6 less than the 13th number, and the 12th number is 4 greater than the 13th number. What is the average of the 11th and 12th numbers?
questions.questionHtml: The average of 13 numbers is 70. The average of the first five numbers is 60. The average of the next five numbers is 25 % higher than the average of the first five numbers. The 11th number is 6 less than the 13th number, and the 12th number is 4 greater than the 13th number. What is the average of the 11th and 12th numbers?
questions.solution:
<svg width="520" height="300" viewBox="0 0 520 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Averages Mechanism Figure -->
  <!-- Proportional Bars: 1 unit = 1.8px, Base Y = 170 -->
  <!-- Avg line at 70: Y = 170 - (70*1.8) = 44 -->
  
  <!-- Group 1: 5 numbers, Avg 60 (Height 108) -->
  <rect x="40" y="62" width="90" height="108" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="40" y="44" width="90" height="18" fill="#ffd6d6" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
  <text x="50" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000">−10 dev.</text>
  <text x="55" y="188" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">1st 5 nos</text>

  <!-- Group 2: 5 numbers, Avg 75 (Height 135) -->
  <rect x="160" y="35" width="90" height="135" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="160" y="35" width="90" height="9" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="175" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">+5 dev.</text>
  <text x="175" y="188" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">Next 5 nos</text>

  <!-- Group 3: 3 numbers, Calculated Avg 78.3 (Height 141) -->
  <rect x="280" y="29" width="70" height="141" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="280" y="29" width="70" height="15" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="282" y="24" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">Avg ≈ 78.3</text>
  <text x="282" y="188" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">11,12,13th</text>

  <!-- Overall Average Line at 70 -->
  <line x1="30" y1="44" x2="380" y2="44" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,4"/>
  <text x="385" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#cc0000">Avg = 70</text>

  <!-- Relationship indicators -->
  <text x="365" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">11th: x − 6</text>
  <text x="365" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">12th: x + 4</text>
  <text x="365" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">13th: x</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution Lines -->
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Sum(last 3) = (13 × 70) − [5 × 60 + 5 × (60 × 1.25)] = 235</text>
  <text x="30" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ (x − 6) + (x + 4) + x = 235 ⇒ 3x − 2 = 235 ⇒ x = 79</text>
  <text x="30" y="285" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 78</text>
</svg>

questions.question: In an election, 80% of eligible voters cast their votes. Of these votes, 5% were declared invalid. If a winning candidate received 11,400 votes, which accounted for 60% of the total valid votes, what was the total number of eligible voters enrolled in that election?
questions.questionHtml: In an election, 80% of eligible voters cast their votes. Of these votes, 5% were declared invalid. If a winning candidate received 11,400 votes, which accounted for 60% of the total valid votes, what was the total number of eligible voters enrolled in that election?
questions.solution:
<svg width="550" height="300" viewBox="0 0 550 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrR" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc0000"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Election Voter Funnel -->
  <!-- Enrolled Voters Layer -->
  <path d="M40,20 L510,20 L480,55 L70,55 Z" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="210" y="42" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">Enrolled Voters (100%)</text>
  <circle cx="190" cy="38" r="5" fill="#555555"/>
  <path d="M182,50 Q190,44 198,50" stroke="#555555" fill="none" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Votes Cast Layer -->
  <path d="M70,55 L480,55 L450,90 L100,90 Z" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="220" y="77" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Votes Cast (80%)</text>
  <path d="M195,68 h10 v10 h-10 z" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M198,65 l4,4 l-4,4" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Valid Votes Layer -->
  <path d="M100,90 L450,90 L420,125 L130,125 Z" fill="#d9f2f2" stroke="#008080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="215" y="112" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#008080">Valid Votes (95%)</text>
  <path d="M190,110 l3,3 l6,-7" stroke="#008080" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Winner Share Layer -->
  <path d="M130,125 L420,125 L390,160 L160,160 Z" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="205" y="148" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">Winner (60%) = 11,400</text>
  
  <!-- Side Exclusions (curved arrows) -->
  <path d="M495,35 Q530,55 500,75" stroke="#cc0000" fill="none" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrR)" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="505" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">20% Absent</text>
  
  <path d="M465,72 Q490,90 465,108" stroke="#cc0000" fill="none" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrR)" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="470" y="95" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">5% Invalid</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->
  <text x="30" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Total Enrolled × 80% × 95% × 60% = 11,400</text>
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Enrolled × (4/5) × (19/20) × (3/5) = 11,400</text>
  <text x="30" y="255" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Enrolled = (11,400 × 500) ÷ 228 = 25,000</text>

  <text x="30" y="285" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 25,000 voters</text>
</svg>

questions.question: The compound interest on a sum at 18 % p.a. for 1 \(\frac12\) years, compounded yearly, is ₹2 862. Find the principal.
questions.questionHtml: The compound interest on a sum at 18 % p.a. for 1\(\frac12\)years, compounded yearly, is ₹2 862. Find the principal.
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: COMPOUND INTEREST SUCCESSIVE GROWTH -->
  <line x1="50" y1="120" x2="450" y2="120" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,3"/>
  
  <!-- Coins / Nodes -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="120" r="22" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc" font-weight="bold">₹ P</text>
  
  <circle cx="250" cy="120" r="18" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="240" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">1 Year</text>
  
  <circle cx="440" cy="120" r="22" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="432" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700" font-weight="bold">₹ A</text>
  <text x="425" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700">1.5 Years</text>

  <!-- Successive Growth Arrows -->
  <path d="M 80 110 Q 155 70 230 110" fill="none" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <text x="135" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" font-weight="bold">+18%</text>

  <path d="M 270 110 Q 355 85 415 110" fill="none" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <text x="325" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" font-weight="bold">+9%</text>

  <!-- Effective Span -->
  <path d="M 60 145 Q 250 190 440 145" fill="none" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrG)"/>
  <text x="170" y="185" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700" font-weight="bold">Net CI = 28.62% = ₹2,862</text>
  <text x="20" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">(9% is rate for half-year)</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALCULATION -->
  <text x="30" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Net CI% = 18 + 9 + (18 × 9) ÷ 100 = 28.62%</text>
  <text x="30" y="235" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Principal = 2862 ÷ 0.2862</text>
  <text x="30" y="255" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = ₹10,000</text>
</svg>

questions.question: If the compound interest on a certain sum at 16 \(\frac23\) per annum for 3 years is ₹1270, find the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate and for the same period.

<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: COMPOUND INTEREST VISUAL (STAIRS) -->
  <line x1="40" y1="160" x2="400" y2="160" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/> <!-- Timeline -->
  
  <!-- Year 1 Bar (Only SI) -->
  <rect x="60" y="88" width="60" height="72" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <text x="165" y="178" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">Year 2</text>

  <!-- Year 3 Bar (SI + Int on Int) -->
  <rect x="260" y="88" width="60" height="72" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="260" y="50" width="60" height="38" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="265" y="128" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">36 u</text>
  <text x="325" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">+13 u</text>
  <text x="265" y="178" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">Year 3</text>

  <!-- SI indicator line -->
  <line x1="60" y1="88" x2="320" y2="88" stroke="#888888" stroke-dasharray="5,3"/>
  <text x="330" y="110" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">SI (Uniform)</text>
  
  <!-- CI Rate Label -->
  <text x="380" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" font-weight="700">R = 1/6</text>
  <path d="M420,50 Q440,80 420,130" fill="none" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrG)"/>
  <text x="415" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500">Compounding</text>

  <!-- Total CI Bracket (Implicitly showing sum) -->
  <text x="330" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Total CI = 127 units</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: SOLUTIONS -->
  <text x="30" y="210" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Rate 16<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="10">2</tspan>/<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">3</tspan>% = 1/6 ⇒ Let P = 6<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="10">3</tspan> = 216 units</text>
  <text x="30" y="230" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ CI = 3(36) + 3(6) + 1 = 127 units → ₹1270</text>
  <text x="30" y="255" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = ₹1080</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A tea seller bought 15 kg of Darjeeling tea at ₹300 per kg and 25 kg of Assam tea at ₹240 per kg. He mixed them together. Due to a slight drop in market prices, he had to sell the entire mixture at ₹260 per kg. Calculate his total profit or loss.
questions.questionHtml: A tea seller bought 15 kg of Darjeeling tea at ₹300 per kg and 25 kg of Assam tea at ₹240 per kg. He mixed them together. Due to a slight drop in market prices, he had to sell the entire mixture at ₹260 per kg. Calculate his total profit or loss.
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#555555"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Darjeeling Tea Bag -->
  <path d="M40,110 Q40,120 55,120 L85,120 Q100,120 100,110 L110,40 L30,40 Z" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="45" y="70" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">15 kg</text>
  <text x="42" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">₹300/kg</text>

questions.question: A 75-liter mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3:2. If 15 liters of this mixture are removed and replaced with 10 liters of pure milk, what is the new ratio of milk to water in the mixture?
questions.questionHtml: A 75-liter mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3:2. If 15 liters of this mixture are removed and replaced with 10 liters of pure milk, what is the new ratio of milk to water in the mixture?
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="280" viewBox="0 0 500 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrR" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc0000"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Mixture Mechanism -->
  <!-- Beaker Outline -->
  <path d="M80,30 L80,140 Q80,155 95,155 L185,155 Q200,155 200,140 L200,30" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <text x="210" y="135" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">Water: 24L</text>

  <path d="M82,110 Q140,105 198,110 L198,60 Q140,55 82,60 Z" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="210" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Milk: 36L</text>

  <!-- Added Milk (Top Layer) -->
  <path d="M82,60 Q140,55 198,60 L198,40 Q140,35 82,40 Z" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
  <text x="210" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">+10L Pure Milk</text>

  <!-- Removal Annotation -->
  <path d="M220,20 Q250,20 250,45" fill="none" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrR)" transform="translate(-160,0) scale(-1,1) translate(-100,0)"/>
  <text x="15" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">−15L Mix</text>

  <path d="M70,40 L60,40 L60,155 L70,155" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="10" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555" transform="rotate(-90 10,105)">Remaining: 60L</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->

<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

questions.question: A can build up a wall in 8 days while B can break it in 3 days. A has worked for 4 days and then B joined to work with A for another 2 days only. In how many days will A alone build up the remaining part of the wall?
questions.questionHtml: A can build up a wall in 8 days while B can break it in 3 days. A has worked for 4 days and then B joined to work with A for another 2 days only. In how many days will A alone build up the remaining part of the wall?
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="280" viewBox="0 0 500 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrR" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc0000"/></marker>
    <pattern id="bricks" x="0" y="0" width="20" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="20" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="0.5"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="0" x2="10" y2="10" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Wall Building/Breaking Mechanism -->
  <text x="350" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555" text-anchor="middle">Total Wall = 24 Units (LCM)</text>
  
  <!-- The Wall Structure -->
  <rect x="310" y="40" width="80" height="120" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="310" y="150" width="80" height="10" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1" />
  <rect x="310" y="40" width="80" height="120" fill="url(#bricks)" opacity="0.3"/>
  
  <!-- Remaining Part Bracket -->
  <path d="M400,40 L410,40 L410,150 L400,150" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="420" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">Remaining (22 units)</text>
  
  <!-- Worker A (Builder) -->
  <g transform="translate(60, 60)">
    <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="10" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M10,50 Q20,30 30,50 Z" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M35,35 L55,25" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
    <text x="20" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc" text-anchor="middle">A: +3 units/d</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Worker B (Breaker) -->
  <g transform="translate(180, 60)">
    <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="10" fill="#ffd6d6" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M10,50 Q20,30 30,50 Z" fill="#ffd6d6" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M35,25 L55,35" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrR)"/>
    <text x="20" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000" text-anchor="middle">B: −8 units/d</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Status indicator -->
  <text x="350" y="175" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">Built: 2 units</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->
  <text x="30" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Efficiencies: E<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">A</tspan> = 24÷8 = 3; E<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">B</tspan> = 24÷3 = −8</text>
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Wall built in 6 days = (4 × 3) + 2(3 − 8) = 12 − 10 = 2 units</text>
  <text x="30" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Remaining days for A = (24 − 2) ÷ 3 = 22/3 days</text>

  <text x="30" y="275" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 7½ days (7 1/3 days)</text>
</svg>

questions.question: An airplane travels a specific distance at a speed of 240 km/h over the course of 5 hours. To cover the same distance in just 1 hour, it needs to fly at a speed of:
questions.questionHtml: An airplane travels a specific distance at a speed of 240 km/h over the course of 5 hours. To cover the same distance in just 1 hour, it needs to fly at a speed of:
questions.solution:
Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 240 × 5 = 1200 km

Required Speed = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Required Speed = 1200 ÷ 1 = 1200 km/h

questions.question: A person travels from city A to city B. If he travels at a speed of 50 km/h, he arrives 1 hour early. If he travels at a speed of 30 km/h, he arrives 1 hour late. What is the distance (in km) between city A and city B?
questions.questionHtml: A person travels from city A to city B. If he travels at a speed of 50 km/h, he arrives 1 hour early. If he travels at a speed of 30 km/h, he arrives 1 hour late. What is the distance (in km) between city A and city B?
questions.solution:
<svg width="450" height="280" viewBox="0 0 450 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrR" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc0000"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Road and Vehicle Mechanism -->
  <line x1="40" y1="100" x2="410" y2="100" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,4"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="100" r="5" fill="#555555"/>
  <text x="35" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">A</text>
  <circle cx="410" cy="100" r="5" fill="#555555"/>
  <text x="405" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">B</text>

  <!-- Car Silhouette -->
  <rect x="200" y="88" width="40" height="10" rx="2" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="100" r="3" fill="#333333"/>
  <circle cx="230" cy="100" r="3" fill="#333333"/>

  <!-- Speed Scenario 1: Faster (Early) -->
  <path d="M60,70 Q225,30 390,70" fill="none" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrG)" />
  <text x="140" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">50 km/h (1 hr Early)</text>

  <!-- Speed Scenario 2: Slower (Late) -->
  <path d="M60,130 Q225,170 390,130" fill="none" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrR)" />
  <text x="140" y="170" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000">30 km/h (1 hr Late)</text>

  <!-- Distance Brace / Gap Label -->
  <path d="M40,110 L40,120 M410,110 L410,120 M40,115 L410,115" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="210" y="130" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">Distance (D)</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution lines -->
  <text x="30" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Time Difference (ΔT) = 1 hr (early) + 1 hr (late) = 2 hours</text>
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Distance = [ (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ − S₂) ] × ΔT</text>
  <text x="30" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Distance = [ (50 × 30) ÷ (50 − 30) ] × 2 = 150 km</text>

  <text x="30" y="275" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 150 km</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A ring-shaped metallic sheet has outer and inner radii 10 cm and 6 cm. What percentage of the full circle's area is the ring?
questions.questionHtml: A ring-shaped metallic sheet has outer and inner radii 10 cm and 6 cm. What percentage of the full circle's area is the ring?
questions.solution:
Area of outer circle ⇒ π × 102 ⇒ π × 100

Area of inner circle ⇒ π × 62 ⇒ π × 36

Area of ring ⇒ π × (100 − 36) ⇒ π × 64

Percentage of full circle ⇒ (π × 64 ÷ π × 100) × 100 ⇒ (64 ÷ 100) × 100 ⇒ 64%

questions.question: The ratio of the circumferences of two circular flower beds is 3:5. If the smaller flower bed has a radius of 9 m, what is the radius of the larger flower bed?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the circumferences of two circular flower beds is 3:5. If the smaller flower bed has a radius of 9 m, what is the radius of the larger flower bed?
questions.solution:
Ratio of circumferences = Ratio of radii

⇒ r1 : r2 = 3 : 5

⇒ 9 : r2 = 3 : 5

⇒ r2 = (9 × 5) ÷ 3

⇒ r2 = 15 m
